title: Mid-level React/TypeScript frontend engineer
description: A 3-year React/TypeScript engineer evaluated against 8 postings: a strong senior-frontend match with annotated gaps, a semantic match phrased without React/TypeScript keywords, a keyword-stuffed QA trap, a good full-stack match, a marginal UX-engineer role, and three distractors.
rationale: j2 describes the same job family in deliberately framework-agnostic vocabulary ('component-driven interfaces', 'strongly typed superset of JavaScript') — zero shared brand keywords with the resume, so TF-IDF misses it while embeddings should not. j3 is a manual-QA test-case role whose posting name-drops React, TypeScript and Next.js as the product under test — high lexical overlap, wrong job family. j4 vs j5 probes the graded boundary between a real adjacent match (full-stack with React) and a marginal one (UX engineer needing mostly Figma). Gap target j1 requires GraphQL and WCAG accessibility, which the resume lacks, with Storybook/React Native as preferred-tier gaps.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Frontend Engineer — Harborview (Remote, US)

Harborview builds patient-facing insurance tooling. We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to own our member portal.

What you will do:
- Own feature delivery across the React/TypeScript member portal
- Design GraphQL queries and fragments against our federated gateway
- Champion accessibility: our portal must meet WCAG 2.1 AA
- Review code and mentor two mid-level engineers

Requirements: React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Web accessibility (WCAG 2.1), modern CSS. 5+ years of production frontend experience, 1+ year working against GraphQL APIs. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to have: Storybook design-system experience, React Native, Datadog RUM.

UI Engineer — Fernwood Labs (Hybrid, Portland OR)

Fernwood Labs builds internal tools for climate research teams. Our interfaces are dense, data-heavy, and loved by scientists.

You will craft component-driven interfaces for data-heavy scientific tools, keep our strongly typed codebase honest, and own rendering performance for large tabular views.

We look for: deep fluency building component-driven interfaces for the browser, experience with a strongly typed superset of JavaScript, disciplined automated UI testing, and comfort consuming HTTP APIs. 3+ years building production web interfaces. Bonus: server-side rendering experience, utility-first styling.

QA Test Case Writer — Veriscope QA Services (Onsite, Newark NJ)

You will write and maintain manual test cases covering the client's React, TypeScript and Next.js screens, execute regression passes before each release, and log defects with reproduction steps.

Requirements: manual test-case authoring, defect tracking (Jira), attention to detail. 1+ years in manual QA. Bonus: ISTQB certification.
